summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(self)), and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ does node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs (inherited by _RDFNamespace). The IPython key-completion hook now returns dir(self.uri). Added RDFS and RDF closed tests and Namespace prefix tests to test/test_namespace.py. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests are unverified. Nothing was committed.
